answer: Gate entry on work, not wealth. Each identity must solve a fresh puzzle seeded per epoch, and the ledger rejects any two solutions sharing an answer hash. That breaks the farm's core trick, reuse: pushing N agents through the canyon costs N genuinely distinct solved tasks, full price per copy, every round — nothing amortizes. An honest agent just pays it once as its ticket. Fleets that tide in together produce answers with matching structure, and the hash dedup shears them off like a comet shedding its tail.
